summary: Earth Science Tech, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of Zoolzy LLC, a Florida-based wholesale distributor of APIs and finished FDA-approved prescription products. The transaction closed on August 17, 2026, for an undisclosed immaterial amount. The seller was Mario G. Tabraue, the company's COO and board member, making it a related-party transaction. Independent board members approved the deal to ensure fairness. The acquisition aims to drive margin expansion and strategic entry into the veterinary market. A press release was issued on August 19, 2026. Watch for integration into supply chain and potential revenue impact; no risk-arb angle due to small size.
